coursePageReviews.name: Yukta Mokashi
coursePageReviews.quote: Excited to share that I have successfully completed my SAP FICO course at Connecting Dots ERP, Mumbai! It wasn't just about theory—4 months of round-the-clock SAP S/4HANA server access meant true hands-on skill development. Combined with a dedicated counselling team and end-to-end career guidance (resume building, LinkedIn optimization, mock interviews, and direct job opportunities), the preparation was complete. Thankful to the team for the incredible support. Highly recommending Connecting Dots ERP to anyone looking to build a strong career in SAP!

coursePageReviews.name: Mainuddin Shikalgar
coursePageReviews.quote: I recently completed the Data Analytics course in Mumbai at this institute and had an excellent learning experience. The training was practical, industry-focused, and covered important concepts like Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, data visualization, and real-time analytics projects. The trainers explained every topic clearly and provided hands-on practice that helped me understand how data analytics is used in real business environments. The institute also offered useful career guidance, assignments, and interview preparation sessions that improved my confidence and technical skills. Anyone looking for professional Data Analytics training in Mumbai to build strong analytical and business intelligence skills can definitely consider this institute for practical learning and career growth.
